name: Airborne IR Search and Track
_frequency_hz: N/A — IR sensor, not radar. IRST operates in infrared wavelengths (~3-12 μm). Not affected by rain attenuation but severely degraded by fog and clouds. The frequency_hz field is ignored for IR sensor types.
_envelope_note: v3.6.16 airborne IRST variant. MechanicalScanLimits elevation envelope widened from default_IRST.json's [-5°, +15°] (ground-based) to [-15°, +25°] (airborne) to accommodate body-frame elevation rotation under ownship bank during turns. Phase 1 analysis: a 30° bank with target at body-frame az ≈ 50° produces ≈ 23° body-frame elevation shift (sin-projection of roll onto target direction), which exceeds the default ground-based envelope ceiling but stays inside the widened airborne envelope. The widening matches real-world airborne IRSTs (e.g., F-35 EOTS, Su-57 OLS-50M) which have broader elevation envelopes than ground-based IRSTs to maintain search coverage through maneuvers. Default_IRST.json is preserved unchanged — v3.6.15 matrix evidence for ground-based IRST remains valid.
_mountingloc_note: MountingLocation [0, 0, 0] = sensor at platform center of mass (airborne). Differs from default_IRST.json's [0, 0, -10] which puts the IRST on a 10m mast above tower platform origin. For an airborne ownship the platform IS the airframe, so no mast offset.
